title: Sign Language Number Learning App
subtitle: Real-time number recognition and arithmetic practice with hand gestures.

home.eyebrow: A little practice makes a big difference
home.headline: Let’s make numbers fun!
home.p1: Use this app to recognize Sri Lankan Sign Language numbers from 0 to 50 in real-time.
home.p2: Then practice addition, subtraction, multiplication, and division using sign-based answers.
home.chooseTitle: What would you like to try?
home.numbersDescription: Show a number sign to the camera and see what it recognizes.
home.gamesDescription: Solve a fun math question using Sri Lankan Sign Language.

recorder.heading: Gesture Recorder
recorder.subtitle: Practice a sign with your camera
recorder.help: Keep your hand inside the frame and record a 3-second gesture.

number.pageTitle: Show a number with your hand
number.pageDescription: Keep your hand in view, record your sign, and discover which number the camera recognizes.
number.waitingHint: Your number will appear here after you record a sign.
number.resultHint: Great signing! Try another number whenever you’re ready.
